idk. its not even sad really. more like nothing. like i graduated in december and everyones asking whats next and i just. shrug. theres nothing there

i mean it was supposed to be the big thing right. four years. and now im just back in my old room and my friends all scattered. i had this whole plan to do grad school but i didnt even apply. couldnt make myself. and now i dont know if i wanted it or just thought i should. everything feels kind of greyed out

foggy i guess. or just like. far away from myself? i sleep a lot. i open my laptop to look at jobs and then 3 hours go by and ive just been staring. its not even that im upset about it. i just cant find the part of me that cares what happens next

i think the out of reach part is like. i used to actually want things. had this image of who id be by now. and shes just not here. and im scared the nothing is gonna stay. but even saying that doesnt feel like much. im kind of tired now honestly

yeah. lets leave it there. it helped a little to say it out loud i think. thanks for not trying to fix it. night
